scope: Shared semantics for a local scientific library, CLI and MCP; actual surfaces are IN04 and matched trials IN05.

operations.purpose: Business statement to explicit alternative causal questions and missing information
operations.limits: No automatic truth or unique target

operations.purpose: Validate graph syntax, timing and evidence for proposed edges
operations.limits: Syntactic checks do not establish causal graph correctness

operations.purpose: Run a selected declared discovery method and preserve equivalence class
operations.limits: No arbitrary latent temporal inference; candidate engine qualification required

operations.purpose: Identify under a supplied graph or return a bounded nonidentification/unsupported disposition
operations.limits: causal_workflow.adjustment_expression handles a supplied DAG/back-door case; unsupported adjustment is not general nonidentification
No automatic bank experimentation or assignment truth

operations.purpose: Run a declared estimator in a declared sampling/model regime
operations.limits: R01/R03 are qualified only in their registered synthetic scopes; R02/R04/R05 remain negative
Sensitivity sets, sampling confidence and posterior credibility remain distinct

operations.purpose: Check source ownership, inclusion, measurement and information-clock declarations
operations.limits: Checks cannot manufacture gold truth or validate declarations scientifically

operations.purpose: Render an evidence-grounded report with conditional/negative conclusions
operations.limits: A report does not promote capability or claim independent acceptance
Availability is exact runtime-specific, not inferred from package names

operations.purpose: Inspect authorized durable job state and result handles
operations.limits: No scientific conclusion follows from completed job status

operations.purpose: Request cooperative cancellation of an authorized job
operations.limits: May race with completion; published complete result remains immutable

request.request_id: Opaque caller correlation string; distinct from idempotency identity.
request.artifact_inputs: ArtifactRef list; no arbitrary local path or network URL in tool input.
request.parameters: Operation-specific versioned fields; unknown fields reject unless explicitly namespaced extensions.

scientific_context.rule: A context digest binds the actual estimand, population, unit/clock, target sign and sampling assumptions; transports cannot edit it.

request.idempotency: Same idempotency key with same normalized scientific request returns the same durable job/result. Same key with different content rejects, never reuses a result.

response.rule: Job/transport success is separate from scientific disposition and qualification. A well-formed negative scientific answer can complete successfully.
response.promotion: Qualified/external claims require exact referenced qualifying/accepting evidence; the transport cannot assign them.
response.error: Null for ordinary scientific disposition; structured code/message/retryable/details for invocation, input or system failure.
response.result: Present only for computed scientific results or a typed non-numeric explanation; a refused/unavailable result cannot smuggle a finite estimate.

set_contract.intervals: Sorted nonoverlapping closed interval union on the extended real line. null is negative infinity only at a lower endpoint and positive infinity only at an upper endpoint.
set_contract.meaning: Empty feasibility, nonidentification and uncomputed/unknown sets are distinct. Never convexify a disconnected union or replace infinity with a large finite cutoff.
set_contract.dimension: One declared unit per coordinate; a multidimensional joint region needs an explicit joint construction or artifact, not just marginal intervals.

uncertainty_contract.level: A probability strictly between zero and one for confidence/credible objects; null for nonprobabilistic sensitivity.
uncertainty_contract.rule: Declared sampling and asymptotic/numerical limits persist. Pointwise intervals never become simultaneous by transport conversion; posterior intervals never become frequentist confidence.

rules: Preserve node identity and time order; do not silently orient a circle/tail ambiguity.
A PAG/CPDAG cannot be relabeled a selected DAG without an explicit lossy conversion and new scientific review.
DAG syntax checks require acyclicity; full PAG/CPDAG class recognition is a separate declared capability.
LLM confidence, prompt agreement and metadata are not statistical causal confidence.
Selection of one graph cannot erase effect uncertainty across retained graphs.
graph_contract.set_representation: DAG_set and temporal_graph_set require one or more opaque, content-hashed member artifacts and no flattened edge list. Their schema and graph-class validity must be checked when resolved by IN04; summary labels alone do not establish set membership.
graph_contract.reference_validator_scope: Checks declared nodes, edge marks, duplicate/self/DAG cycles and set member-handle presence. Does not recognize every valid/invalid CPDAG, PAG, ADMG or temporal equivalence class.

artifact_contract.identity: Opaque id resolved only inside a configured authorized root; verify hash and schema before reading.
artifact_contract.custody: Local by default. Owner/read policy and derivation chain travel with the handle; no automatic upload.
artifact_contract.publication: Write partial artifacts privately, verify and atomically publish only completed outputs; result refers to content identity.

job_contract.recovery: Resume only with matching immutable scientific/input/code identities; changed request creates a new job. A checkpoint or partial result is not a completed result.
job_contract.cancellation: Cooperative request; report observed final state. Never claim cancellation rolled back a published result. Cancellation of the short MCP request is distinct from cancellation of a durable job.
job_contract.ordering: Deterministic work IDs and idempotent publication; retry does not double-count requests or hide failures.

compatibility.major: Breaking semantics or schema require a new major identity and explicit migration.
compatibility.minor: Additive optional fields may be negotiated; unknown scientific meanings reject.
compatibility.legacy_v04: Adapter must explicitly map scientific.py axes/units/uncertainty, preserving scope; engineering_v11 result fields alone are insufficient to certify full request/target compatibility.
compatibility.missing_optional: Absence stays unknown; defaults may not invent a sampling law, target population, clock or causal premise.

acceptance_examples: A whole-line set remains [[null,null]] on every surface.
A disconnected weak-IV set is not serialized as its convex hull.
An input declared independent by row cannot inherit trajectory/cluster inference without a changed context.
CardNPV historical-minus-perfect value cannot be inverted by a unit conversion.
A late feature is rejected by a before-decision contract even if its timestamp is missing.
Unsupported identification returns unsupported, not proved nonidentification.
